title: Volley Release Playbook
description: A repository's release playbook, <repo>/.volley/release.yaml (spec section 4.6.19): the stages a supervisor runs, in order, once a wave's tasks are all merged: the prepare stages before it asks the owner release_go, the ship stages after the go. brief, each run argv element, verify.tag and verify.result values may name the variables {{version}}, {{date}}, {{wave}}, {{release_branch}}, {{default_branch}} and (ship stages only) {{merged_sha}}; any other {{name}} is refused by the supervisor's parser. Authored as YAML; this schema validates the parsed document. Not an envelope. Generic hooks: each stage is a brief for the agent that runs it, the commands it runs, and the facts the supervisor checks afterwards. Stage names are unique (enforced by the supervisor's parser with a path-qualified error).

stages.description: The release stages, run in this order.

name.description: Stage name, unique in the playbook.

brief.description: What the stage's agent does, in prose. May name the playbook variables.

run.description: Commands the stage's agent runs, each an argv array (never a shell line); shown in its brief verbatim. Each element may name the playbook variables, substituted before the agent sees it.

phase.description: prepare: runs before the owner's release_go, on the release branch. ship: runs after release_go's go, once the supervisor squash-merged the release PR, in a detached worktree at the merge commit on the default branch; it pushes nothing but a tag. Prepare stages come first; a ship stage needs a prepare stage that verifies release_pr, and never verifies commits_on_release or release_pr itself.

gate.description: owner: the supervisor opens a stage_go decision and runs the stage only on go (how a deploy-shaped stage asks first). auto: it runs when the stage before it is verified.

verify.description: Facts the supervisor checks once the stage reports done; the stage is verified only when every one holds.

commits_on_release.description: true: the stage pushed at least one commit to the release branch.

release_pr.description: true (a prepare stage's): exactly one open pull request from the release branch into the default branch, labelled no-changelog, its title starting release:. The supervisor merges it on the owner's release_go go.

tag.description: A tag matching this glob exists at the release branch's head (a ship stage's: at the release's merge commit).

files.description: Paths that must exist on the release branch.

result.description: Fields the stage's result payload must carry, each with exactly this value.

timeout_s.description: How long the stage may run before it fails.

heavy.description: A lease pool (config lease_pools key) the stage holds a lease from while it runs.

templated.description: Text that may name the playbook variables as {{name}}: version, date, wave, release_branch, default_branch, merged_sha. Any other {{…}} is refused.

allOf.description: A ship stage needs a prepare stage that verifies release_pr (the pull request the supervisor merges on the go).
